color.note: Two themes: Paper is the lit desk the design was drawn on; Night is the same desk after dark. Every ground drops to a warm near-black, ink turns to cream, kraft darkens so cream reads on it, and the four signal colours lift a step so they keep their contrast on the dark grounds. "value" is the Paper hex, "night" the Night one; alias tokens follow whatever they alias.
